(ba)༄༅/ /dbang bskur ba dngos bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇḍal phul la/me tog bzung nas 'di skad ces/oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/de bzhi

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dbang bskur ba dngos bzhugs// ༄༅// de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇḍal phul la/ me tog bzung nas 'di skad ces/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i cho ga chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣṭhi te badzra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog dang spos thogs la/ 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes 'don pa bsgyur la/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas spyi bor bum pa bzhag la 'di skad ces/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharm+mā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ na mo na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwa dharma saṃ ghe bhyaḥ tadya thā/ oṃ bi pu la bi pu la garbhe/ bi pu la/ bi ma le/ bi pu la garbhe/ bi ma le/ dza ya garbhe/ badzra dzwā lā garbhe/ ga ti ga ha ne ga ga na bi sho dha ne/ sarba pā pa bi sho dha ne/ oṃ gu ṇa ba ti/ ga ga na pi tsā ri ṇi/ ga ga ri ṇi/ gi gi gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri ga ma ri/ ga ha ga ha/ garga ri garga ri/ ga ga ri/ ga ga ri/ gambha ri gambha ri/ ga bhi/ ga bhi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ma ni ga ma ni/ ga ri ga ri/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru gu ru/ gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ mu tse le/ mu tse le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ sarba bha ya/ bi ga te/ satwa sarba garbha saṃ rakṣa ṇi/ si ri si ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri samnata parṣa ṇi/ bha ga wa tī/ satwā nā ya ki sa manta nā ya ki sarba sha trūṃ pra ma rda ni/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ/ sarba satwā ñtsa sarba dā/ sarba bha ye bhyaḥ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥ sarba bya dhi bhya ñdza/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi ga ta/ ā wa ra ṇe bi sho dha ne/ bi bi dha/ ā ba ra ṇa/ bi nā sha ni/ mu ri mu ri/

mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi li/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ bi dza yā ba he/ dza ya wa ti/ bi she ṣa ba ti/ bha ga ba tī ma hā bi dyā ratna ma ku ṭa mā la dha ri/ bī hu bi bi dhā bi tsi tra bi shwa dha ri ṇi/ bha ga wa tī ma hā bi dyā de wī/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sa pa ri wā ra/ sarba satwā ñtsa/ sa manta sarba tra/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba satwā ñtsa/ a nā tha/ na tra yā/ na sha ra ṇa/ na pa ra ya ṇa na/ pa ri mo tsa ya sarba duḥkhe bhyaḥ tsaṇḍe tsaṇḍe/ tsaṇḍe tsaṇḍe/ tsaṇḍi ṇi tsaṇḍi ṇi/ be ga wa ti/ sarba duṣṭā ni bā ra ṇi/ bi dza ya bā hi ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ a yuḥpa li ni/ su ra ba ra pra ma tha ni/ sarba de wa ga ṇa pū dzi te/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sa manta a wa lo ki te/ pra bhe pra bhe/ su pra bhe/ su pra bha/ bi shuddhe/ sarba pā pa bi shuddhe/ sarba pā pa bi sho dha ne/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dha ra ṇi/ dha re dha re/ dha ra/ su mu su mu/ su mu su mu/ mu su mu su/ ru ru tsa le tsā la ya/ sarba duṣṭhā nā shāshsha ra ṇa bha wa tu māṃ/ ā sha sū ra ya māṃ/ shrī wa su dha ri/ dza ya ka ma le/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ ba ra da/ aṃ ku she oṃ padma bi shuddhe/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ shuddhe shuddhe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṃ ga la bi shuddhe/ ba bi tra mu khi khaḍgi ni/ khaḍgi ni/ kha ra kha ra/ dzwa li ta/ shi kha re/ sa manta a ba lo ki ta pra bhe/ su pra bi shuddhe/ sa manta pra sā ri ta/ a bā bha si ta shuddha/ dzwa la dzwa la/ sarba de wa ga ṇa/ gra ha/ nakṣa tra/ sa ma ā karṣa ṇi/ satya pra ti oṃ hrī trāṃ tā ra tā ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya māṃ/ bha ga wa tī sarba satwa shtsa/ na ga bya ba lo ki ti/ la hu la hu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu du hu du/ tu ru tu ru/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ hu ṇi hu ṇi/

sarba gra ha bakṣa ṇi/ piṃ ga la piṃ ga le/ mu tsu mu tsu/ tsu mu tsu mu/ su bi tsa re/ ta ra ta ra/ na ga bya ba lo ki ni/ tā ra ya māṃ/ sarba satwa ñtsa/ bha ga wa tī/ aṣṭa ma hā tā ra ya bha ye bhyaḥsarba tra sa manta sarba di sha bandhe na/ badzra prā kā ra/ badzra pā sha bandhe na tsa/ badzra dzwā lā bi shuddhe/ bhu ri bhu ri/ dha ra dha ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ bha ga wa tī/ garbha bi shuddha/ garbha saṃ sho dha ni/ ku kṣi/ saṃ pū ra ṇi/ dzwa la dzwa la/ tsa la tsa la/ dzwā li ni dzwā li ni/ barṣa tu de wa sa mantā she ya u da ke ta/ a mṛ ta barṣa ṇi de wa tā a ba tā ra ṇi/ a bhi ṣiñtsantu maṃ/ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na/ a mṛ ta ba ra pu ṣe/ rakṣa rakṣa bha ga wa tī māṃ/ sarba tra/ sarba dhā/ sarba bha ya bhyaḥ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥ sarba u pa sarghe bhyaḥ sarba bya dhi bhyaḥ sarba duṣṭā bhyaḥ ya ba ti bhyaḥ sarba ki li ki la ha/ bi gra ha bi bā dā/ dursapna/ durni mitta/ a maṃ ga la/ pā pa bi sho dha ni/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa/ na ga pi dā ra ṇi/ ba la ba la/ ba la ba ti dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya tu māṃ/ sarba tā sarba kā le/ sidhyantu me i yaṃ ma hā bidyā/ sā dha ya maṇḍa laṃ/ sā dha ya mant+ran/ ghā ta ya bighnān/ dza ya dza ya/ siddhyi siddhyi/ siddhya siddhya/ buddhya buddhya/ su tsa ya sū tsa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ pū ra ya me ā shān/ sarba bidyā uṅga ta murti/ dza yo adhi/ dza ya ba ti ni/ tiṣṭhatiṣṭha bha ga wa tī/ sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ye shuddhe/ bya ba lo ka ra ya māṃ sa pa ri wā raṃ sarba satwā shtsa aṣṭa ma hā bha ye bhyaḥ sarba ā shaṃ pa ri pū ra ya/ tra ya swā/ ma hā bha ye bhyaḥ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni/ sa manta ā ka ra maṇḍal bi shuddhe/ bi ga te bi ga t-i/ bi ga ta ma le/ sarba ma la bi sho dha ni/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ sarba pā pa bi shuddhe/ ma la bi ga ti/

dza ya ba ti/ te dzo te dzo ba ti/ badzra badzra ba ti swā hā/ trai lo kya a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta murdha a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba bo dhi satwa a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba de wa tā a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya siddhe swā hā/ int+ra int+ra bya ba lo ki te swā hā/ brahme brahma dhu ṣi te swā hā/ biṣṇu na ma skri te swā hā/ ma he shwa ra bandha da pū dzi te ye swā hā/ badzra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ba la birya a dhiṣṭhā te swā hā/ dhṛ ta rāṣṭā ya swā hā/ bi ru ṭa kā ya swā hā/ bi ru pakṣā ya swā hā/ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ tsa turma hā rā dzā na ma skri tā ya swā hā/ ya ma ye swā hā/ ya ma pū dzi ti na ma skri tā ya swā hā/ bā ru ṇā ya swā hā/ ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ma hā ma ru tā ya swā hā/ agna ye swā hā/ nā ga bya ba lo ki te ye swā hā/ de wa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ nā ga ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ yakṣa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ya ma ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ rākṣa sa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ gandharba ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ a su ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ga ru ḍa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ kanni ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ma ho ra ga ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ma nuṣye ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ a ma nuṣya ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba bhū te bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pi shā tse bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba unmā de bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba a pa smā re bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba kumbhaṇḍe bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pū ta ne bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba ka ṭa pū ṭa ni bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba duṣṭa pra duṣṭe bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ oṃ tu ru tu ru swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ ha na ha na sarba sha trūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba duṣṭāṃ swā hā/

oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra tyā rti kā/ pra tyaṃ mi trā nāṃ swā hā/ ye ma ma a hā ti ā she na te ṣāṃ sarba sha rī raṃ dzwā la ya dzwā la ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ tsittā nāṃ swā hā/ dzwā li ta ye swā hā/ pra dzwā li tā ya swā hā/ badzra dzwā lā ya swā hā/ agni dzwā lā ya swā hā/ sa manta dzwā lā ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ pūrṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ ma hā kā lā swā hā/ ma tri ga ṇā ya swā hā/ yakṣa ṇi naṃ swā hā/ rākṣa si ni naṃ swā hā/ ā kā sha ma tṛ ṇaṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra ba si naṃ swā hā/ ra tṛ tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ dī ba tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ tri sandha tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ be la tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ a be la tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ garbha ha re bhyaḥswā hā/ garbhaya hi ri ṇi bhyaḥswā hā/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ swaḥswā hā/ bhuḥswā hā/ bhuḥwa swā hā/ oṃ bhurbhu waḥswā hā/ bi li bi li swā hā/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi swā hā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ agni swā hā/ te dzo wa yu swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ si li si li swā hā/ buddhya buddhya swā hā/ siddhya siddhya swā hā/ maṇḍa la bandhe swā hā/ sī mā bandhe swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi bandhe swā hā/ sarba sha trūṃ/ bhañdza ya bhañdza ya swā hā/ dzambha ya dzambha ya swā hā/ stambha ya stambha ya swā hā/ tshinda tshinda swā hā/ bhinda bhinda swā hā/ bhañdza bhañdza swā hā/ bandha bandha swā hā/ mo ha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bi shuddhe swā hā/ sūrye swā hā/ sūrya bi shuddhe swā hā/ sho dha ni swā hā/ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ tsand+re tsand+re pa ri purṇa tsand+re swā hā/ gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ nakṣa tre bhyaḥswā hā/ pi shā tsi bhyaḥswā hā/ shi phi bhyaḥswā hā/ bi shwa bhyaḥswā hā/ shānti bhyaḥswā hā/ puṣṭiṃ bhyaḥswā hā/ swa sti ya ne bhyaḥswā hā/

garba dha re swā hā/ shi pam̐ ka ri swā hā/ sham̐ ka ri swā hā/ shāntiṃ ka ri swā hā/ puṣṭiṃ ka ri swā hā/ ba la bardha ne swā hā/ ba la bardhi ni ka ri swā hā/ shrī ka ri swā hā/ shrī bardhi ni swā hā/ shrī dzwā li ni swā hā/ mu tsi swā hā/ na mu tsi swā hā/ mu ru tsi swā hā/ be ga ba ti swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga te mūrti ba ra bi ma le bha ga wa ti/ swa ti bha wa tu/ ma ma sarba satwā ñtsa swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ dha ri tsa la tsa la ni/ bha ga wa ti/ bha ya bi ga te/ bha ya ha ri ṇi/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ buddhi li buddhi li/ tsumbu li tsumbu li swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya dzuṣṭe swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni ba re/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sarba satwa shtsa sarba ta thā ga ta/ sarba bidyā a bhi ṣe kairma hā badzra ka tsa/ mu dre te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣṭhā na/ a dhiṣṭhi te badzre swā hā/ dbang bskur ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //tadya thā/ oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ gi ri ba ti/ gu ṇa ba ti/ ā kā sha ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shuddhe/ sarba pā pa bi ga te/ ā kā sha ga ga na ta le/ ā kā sha bi tsā ri ṇi/ dzwā lī ta shi kha ra/ ma ṇi mukti ka kha tsi ta mau li dha re/ su ke she me ke she su ṣa su bka tre/ su ne tre su barṇe/ su barṇa gau ri/ a tī te/ a nutpanne/ a nā ga te/ pra tyutpannen maḥsarbe ṣān/ buddha nān/ dzwa li ta te dza sā na/ buddhe su buddhe/ bha ga wa ti/ su rakṣa ni sukṣe me/ su pra bhe/ su da me/ su dānti/ ba re ba re warte/ bha ga wa ti/ bha dra ba ti/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ bi ma le/ dza ya bha dre/ pra tsaṇḍi tsaṇḍi/ pra tsaṇḍe/ pra tsaṇḍe/ badzra tsaṇḍe/ ma hā tsaṇḍe/ ma hā tsaṇḍe/ gau ri/ tsau ri/ tsaṇḍā lī/ mā tāṃ gi brtsa si/ pukka si/ su ma ti/ sha ba ri/ shā ba ri/ shaṃ ka ri/ dra mi ḍi/ drā mi ḍi/ rau tri ni/

sarba gra ha bi dā ri ṇi artha sā dha ni/ ha na ha na/ sarba sha trūṃ/ da ha da ha/ sarba dūṣṭān/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ ḍā ki nī nāṃ/ ma nuṣyā/ a ma nuṣyā nāñtsa/ pa tsa pa tsa hṛ da ya na/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams kyi srog gzhom du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gi sdig pa thams cad gzhig tu gsol/ gzhig tu gsol/ thams cad du 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las bdag la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ ma rungs pa thams cad bcing du gsol/ sarba kilpi ṣa nā sha ni/ mārta ṇḍa/ mṛ tyū daṇḍa ni bā ra ṇi/ mā na na/ daṇḍa mā na ni/ ma hā mā ni ni/ ma hā bi ṇi ṭi/ tsa le tsa le/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi/ bi ṭi bi ṭi/ ni ṭi ni ṭi/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ na tu ṭi/ gau ri ṇi/ bī ri ṇi/ pra ba ra sa ma re/ tsaṇḍa lī/ mā tāṃ gi rundha si/ sa ra si/ brtsa si/ su ma ti/ pukka si/ sha ba ri/ shā ba ri/ sham̐ ka ri/ dra mi ḍi/ drā mi ḍi/ da ha ni/ pa tsa ni/ ma tha ni/ marda ni/ sa ra li/ sa ra le/ sa ra laṃ bhe/ hī na ma dhyoṅkiraṣṭa/ bi dhā ra ṇi/ bi dhā ri ṇi/ ma hi le/ ma hā ma hi le/ ni ga ḍe/ ṇi ga ḍe/ bhañdze/ matti matti ni/ dānti tsakre/ tsakra bā gi ni/ dzwa le dzwa le/ dzwā le dzwā le/ dzwā la ni/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shā ba ri shā ba ri/ sarba byā dhi/ ha ra ṇi/ tsū ḍi tsū ḍi/ tsū ḍi ni tsū ḍi ni/ ma hā tsū ḍi ni/ ni mi ni mi/ ni mindha ri/ tri lo ka da ha ni/ tri lo ka ā lo ka kā ri/ trai dhā tu ka bya ba lo ki ni/ badzra pa ra shu/ pā sha mutka ra/ khaḍga/ shaṅkha/ tsakra/ tri shū la/ tsintā ma ṇi/ ma hā bidyā dhā ra ṇi/ bdag thams cad du gnas thams cad du gnas pa na ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nad thams cad dang*/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung su gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// badzre badzre badzra ba ti/ badzra pā ṇi dha re/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li/ pi li pi li/

si li si li/ ba ra ba ra ba ra de/ sarba tra/ dza ya labdhe swā hā/ sarba pā pa bi dā ri ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba sha trūn bha ya ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba bha ra ṇi swā hā/ swa stirbha ba tu māṃ swā hā/ shāntiṃ ka ri swā hā/ puṣṭiṃ ka ri swā hā/ ba la bardha ri ṇi swā hā/ dza ya tu/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya ba ti/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ bi pu le swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta mūrti swā hā/ oṃ bhu ri ma hā shānti swā hā/ oṃ bhū ri bhū ri badzra ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya pū ra ṇi/ ā yussandhā ra ṇi/ ba la ba la ba la ba ti/ dza ya bi dzi ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma ste bcu gsum pa'o// //bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshig bden pa rnams dang 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang*/ dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na dge sbyong skyid de ba zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste/ mi skrag mi 'bros la 'jigs pa med cing*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa spangs pa/ skyi bung zhes byed pa med pa'o zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ dka' thub dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po'i bu thu bo dang 'dra ba rab tu byung nas ring du lon pa tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/

dge slong kun shes kau ḍi n+ya dang*/ 'dod pa nyung ba dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang*/ cho ga shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang*/ shes rab che ba dang*/ spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul che ba dang*/ mthu che ba rnams yi mchog maung gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang*/ chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang*/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len dang*/ khyim pa dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po chen po 'char ka dang*/ lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chu'am/ dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam gol bar 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bsrung bar bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas sam/

'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des/ rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khyim mam/ nags sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams gcad par bya'o// 'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ brjod pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //nad pa'i zas dang*/ skom dang*/ sman rnams kyang rig sngags 'dis btab ste stsal bar bgyi'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas rnam par sangs rgyas tshe// 'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas// snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su// bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang*// mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa// lha yi snod mchog de dang ni// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog

/de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis// lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra// blangs nas ston la rab phul ba// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// nad pa rnams kyi nad sel cing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*// 'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /nad pa shar phyogs kha bstan la// sman rnams nye bar stsal bar bgyi// de yi tshe na rig sngags 'di// lag mthil gzhag ste klag par bgyi// syādya the dan/ kha ṭe kha ṭe/ kha ṭe bi kha ṭe/ bi ma le/ bi laṃ be/ ba le/ ba la ba ti/ tsand+re/ tsa ra ṇe/ a mṛ ta nirgho ṣe swā hā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur// bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur// nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste// bdag la rtag tu bde legs shog /bram ze rnams kyis bslus nas su// shākya seng ge skyob pa la// dpal sbas kyis ni dug can gyi// bsod snyoms dag ni phul ba dang*// de las de ni blangs nas su// ston pas dug ni bsad nas gsol// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su// zas ni bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rnam par gzigs la lha gang dang*// gtsug tor can dang kun skyob dang*// log par dad pa sel ba dang*// stobs chen lha gang dad pa dang*// gser dang dpal ldan 'od srungs dang*// shākya yi ni seng ge la// rab dad lha yi dbang po dang*// tshangs dbang sum cu'i dbang phyug dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang*// nor bu bzang dang dbang phyug che// srin mo nag mo chen mo dang*// de bzhin gdol ma gtum mo dag /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang*// bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di bzhes shig

/de dag tshim zhing mchod gyur nas// bdag gi kha zas byang bar mdzod// zas lnga dag dang 'dres pa yang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// zas de kun ni bza' bar bgyi// sa bon dag gi tshogs kun la// sa yi bcud ni zhugs pa yi// kha zas 'dres pa thams cad kyang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// ji ltar skud pa bcad bsregs kyang*// de lta bur yang slar 'byor pa// de ltar zas rnams 'dres pa yang*// ma 'dres pari na bdag la mdzod// syādya the dan/ kha kha me/ kha kha/ kha kha/ kha kha me/ shi me/ shi me/ shi hū me/ shi ma/ shi me swa sti swa sti/ swa sti swa sti ma ma shintaṃ/ shā rā gri/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// ji ltar ma 'dres zas bzhin du// gang gis ji ltar skud bsregs pa// de 'dra'i bden pa mdzad du gsol// syādya the dan/ ka la ke ka la le/ pa la ni/ ka ru ta ā la ye/ agne/ sam̐ krā ma ṇe swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang sangs rgyas gtsug tor can// bde gshegs kun skyob sangs rgyas log par dad sel dang*// gser thub 'od srungs shākya thub pa gau ta mya// bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi// mi mchog bdun po de dag gi ni sku rnams la// me tog dag dang spos rnams kyis ni mchod par bgyi// lus dang ngag dang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni// de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la// lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi// lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' 'gyur nas// rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol// //'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa dang*// mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa'ang*// de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa// mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas// shes pas shākya thub de rab tu phye// bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa// chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa// ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag bsgrub pa// rdo rje lta bu mi gnyis lam mthong ba// ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde logs shog /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*// gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni// drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa// bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas shes gsungs// de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te// zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin// 'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing*// gau ta ma yi bstan la 'jug byed pa// de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug thob ste// mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni// 'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig char spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni mchog thob shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed la// glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing*// de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa// phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar// 'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi// gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yi// 'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom zhing*// lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni// de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba// lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid// de ltar kun tu sbyor ba rab btang ba// sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mis ni mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis// shin tu bden pa gsung zhing brdzun med pa// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig swā hā// //shis pa brjod pa ste bco lnga pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
